# Evaluation

This folder contains the topic page for Evaluation, which tracks the performance of specific clinical quality indicators against their established development targets. The page documents that national and regional development goals—such as achieving ≥ 90% for Indikator 2, Indikator 3, and Indikator 4y, and 80% for Indikator 4x—were largely unmet, though some indicators showed positive trends.

## Pages

- [[evaluation|Evaluation]] — Tracks the achievement of development targets (udviklingsmål) for clinical indicators like Indikator 2, 3, 4x, and 4y, noting widespread failure to meet the ≥ 90% and 80% thresholds nationally and regionally.
